This document outlines the figures that will be generated in the urban phenology project.

# Data and methods

## Study area map

Distribution of city samples. The geometry location of selected cities. The size of the circle represents the number of trees in the city/number of species. The PCA location of selected cities. Or some separate figures to show the distribution of characteristics.

```{r fig-spatial}
#| warning: false

inventory_centroids <- readRDS(("~/lab-data/datasets/vegetation/StreetTrees/cleaned_ps_input/summary/inventory_centroids.rds"))
boundary_us <- st_read(("~/lab-data/datasets/boundary/USAdministrative/US/us_boundarydissolve.shp"), quiet = T) |> 
  st_transform(4326)

p_geo <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = boundary_us, fill = "grey85", color = "white") +
  geom_sf(data = inventory_centroids, aes(size = num_tree), color = "darkblue", alpha = 0.6) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Number of Trees", range = c(1, 8),labels = label_comma()) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "transparent")) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.ticks   = element_line(linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey90", linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.15)
  )
```

```{r fig-pca}
#| warning: false
#| include: true
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of cities with tree inventories."
#| fig-width: 15
#| fig-height: 7
city_feature <- readRDS("~/lab-data/datasets/vegetation/StreetTrees/cleaned_ps_input/summary/city_feature.rds")

all_city <- readRDS("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/urban/City_list/all_city.rds") |>
  na.omit()
scaled_matrix <- scale(all_city |>
  select(pop_density,bio1, bio12, sd, median)|>
    rename(building_height_sd = sd,
           building_height_median = median)) 
all_city_scaled <- as.data.frame(scaled_matrix)
all_city_scaled$NAME20 <- all_city$NAME20

pca_res <- prcomp(all_city_scaled[, 1:5], center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x[, 1:2])
colnames(pca_scores) <- c("PC1", "PC2")
pca_scores$NAME20 <- all_city_scaled$NAME20

pca_loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_res$rotation[, 1:2])
pca_loadings$variable <- rownames(pca_loadings)

arrow_scale <- 5.5
pca_loadings <- pca_loadings |>
  mutate(PC1 = PC1 * arrow_scale,
         PC2 = PC2 * arrow_scale,
         variable = case_when(
    variable == "building_height_sd"     ~ "height_sd",
    variable == "building_height_median" ~ "height_median",
    TRUE ~ variable 
  ))

list_city <- city_feature |>
  st_join(st_read(("~/lab-data/datasets/boundary/USAdministrative/USCities/tl_2024_us_uac20.shp"), quiet = T) |> 
            st_transform(4326) |>
            dplyr::select(NAME20), join = st_nearest_feature) |>
  pull(NAME20)

pca_scores <- pca_scores |>
  mutate(
    selected = NAME20 %in% list_city,
    hover_text = paste("City:", NAME20),
    group = case_when(
      selected ~ "Selected cities",
      TRUE ~ "Other cities"
    )
  )

full_data <- pca_scores |> select(PC1, PC2)
subset_data <- pca_scores |> filter(selected) |> select(PC1, PC2)

density = 0.0001
num_grids = 100
x_breaks <- seq(min(pca_scores$PC1), max(pca_scores$PC1), length.out = num_grids +1)
y_breaks <- seq(min(pca_scores$PC2), max(pca_scores$PC2), length.out = num_grids +1)

df <- pca_scores |>
    mutate(
      x_bin = cut(PC1, breaks = x_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE),
      y_bin = cut(PC2, breaks = y_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE),
      grid_id = paste(x_bin, y_bin, sep = "_")
    )
  
grid_full <- expand.grid(
  x_bin = 1:(length(x_breaks) - 1),
  y_bin = 1:(length(y_breaks) - 1)
) |>
  mutate(
    grid_id = paste(x_bin, y_bin, sep = "_"),
    PC1 = (x_breaks[x_bin] + x_breaks[x_bin + 1]) / 2,
    PC2 = (y_breaks[y_bin] + y_breaks[y_bin + 1]) / 2
  ) |>
  left_join(
    df |>
      group_by(x_bin, y_bin) |>
      summarise(count = n(),
                subset = sum(selected),
                .groups = "drop"),
    by = c("x_bin", "y_bin")
  )

kde_full <- kde(x = full_data, eval.points = grid_full |> select(PC1, PC2))
kde_subset <- kde(x = subset_data, eval.points = grid_full|> select(PC1, PC2))

dens_full <- kde_full$estimate / sum(kde_full$estimate)
dens_subset <- kde_subset$estimate / sum(kde_subset$estimate)

grid_df <- cbind(grid_full,
                 full_density = dens_full,
                 subset_density = dens_subset)

contour_df <- grid_df %>%
  select(PC1, PC2, full_density, subset_density) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(full_density, subset_density),
    names_to = "group", values_to = "density"
  ) %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(
    group == "full_density"   ~ "All cities",
    group == "subset_density" ~ "Selected cities",
    TRUE ~ group
  ))
  
p_pca <- ggplot(pca_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
  geom_segment(data = pca_loadings,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1, yend = PC2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.5, "cm")),
               color = "red", size = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = pca_loadings,
            aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = variable),
            color = "red", size = 2.5, hjust = -0.2, vjust = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = filter(pca_scores, !(selected)),
             aes(color = "Other cities"), alpha = 0.3, size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = filter(pca_scores, selected),
             aes(color = "Selected cities"), size = 1) +
  # geom_text(data = filter(pca_scores, selected),
  #           aes(label = NAME20), size = 2, vjust = -1) +
  # geom_text(data = filter(pca_scores,  !selected & GUTI_list),
  #           aes(label = NAME20), size = 2, vjust = -1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "City Category",
    values = c(
      "Other cities" = "grey60",
      "Selected cities" = "darkblue"
    )
  ) +
  new_scale_color() +
    geom_contour(data = contour_df,
                 aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, z = density, color = group),
                 breaks = c(density)) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "Density Contour",
      values = c("All cities" = "grey50", "Selected cities" = "cornflowerblue")
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "PC1", y = "PC2")+
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.8)

p_geo + p_pca +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, 
              guides = "collect",
              widths = c(2, 1))
```

## Remote sensing data processing

# Results

## Variation of phenology across cities

### Just phenology variation

Distribution of phenology variation measured by Tukey’s whisker range, with each sample corresponding to a City–Species–Year combination.

```{r}
plot_phe_cities <- function(cities, taxon_col, stats = "sd"){
  pairs <- lapply(c("SOS", "EOS"), function(phe_type) {
    all_city_input <- read_rds(paste0("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/all_", phe_type, "_input.rds"))
    fixed_city <- unique(all_city_input$city) |>
      sort()
    color_palette <- setNames(viridis(length(fixed_city)), fixed_city)
    
    summary_data <- all_city_input %>%
      dplyr::group_by(city, year, .data[[taxon_col]]) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        obs = n(),
        sd = sd(doy, na.rm = TRUE),
        IQR_d = quantile(doy, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) - quantile(doy, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        lower_whisker_d = max(quantile(doy, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) - 1.5 * IQR_d, min(doy, na.rm = TRUE)),
        upper_whisker_d = min(quantile(doy, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) + 1.5 * IQR_d, max(doy, na.rm = TRUE)),
        whisker_d = upper_whisker_d - lower_whisker_d,
        .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      mutate(genus = str_extract(.data[[taxon_col]], "^[^ ]+"))
    
    title_text <- if(taxon_col == "canonicalname") {
      "Each sample represents a species–city combination"
    } else {
      "genus"
    }
    
    x_label <- if(stats == "sd") {
      paste0("Standard Deviation of ", phe_type, " (doy)")
    } else if(stats == "IQR_d") {
      paste0("Interquartile range of ", phe_type, " (doy)")
    } else if(stats == "whisker_d") {
      paste0("Tukey whisker range of ", phe_type, " (doy)")
    } else {
      stop("Invalid stats argument. Choose from 'sd', 'IQR_D', or ' whisker_d'.")
    }
    
    binwidth <- if(stats == "sd") {
      2
    } else if(stats == "IQR_d") {
      4
    } else if(stats == "whisker_d") {
      4
    } else {
      stop("Invalid stats argument. Choose from 'sd', 'IQR_D', or ' whisker_d'.")
    }
    
    p_density <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = .data[[stats]], fill = city)) +
      # geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, position = "identity", alpha = 0.5) +
      geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette) + 
      labs(x = x_label) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
            title = element_text(size = 14),
            legend.position = "NA")
    
    p_hist <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = .data[[stats]])) +
      geom_histogram(binwidth = binwidth, position = "identity", alpha = 0.5) +
      # geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
      # scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette) + 
      labs(x = x_label) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
            title = element_text(size = 14),
            legend.position = "right")
    list(density = p_density, hist = p_hist)
  })
  
    p_density_all <- wrap_plots(lapply(pairs, `[[`, "density"), ncol = 2) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect")

    p_hist_all <- wrap_plots(lapply(pairs, `[[`, "hist"), ncol = 2)
  
    return(list(city_density = p_density_all, cities_histogram = p_hist_all))
}

tree_dir <- "~/lab-data/datasets/vegetation/StreetTrees/cleaned_ps_input/"
rds_files <- list.files(tree_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
cities <- gsub("\\.rds$", "", basename(rds_files))

# sd, whisker_d, IQR_d
whisker_sp <- plot_phe_cities(cities, "canonicalname", stats = "whisker_d")
whisker_sp$city_density / whisker_sp$cities_histogram +
  plot_annotation(title = "Each sample represents a species–city-year combination")
```


### Phenology variation and temperature variation (one city)

```{r}
source(here("script/spatial_stats_model/prepare_model_input.R"))
city = "Moab"

plot_phe_temp_city <- function(city, taxon_col){
  plots <- lapply(c("SOS", "EOS"), function(phe_type) {
    model_input_all <- prepare_data(city, source = "Grid", taxa_col= taxon_col, phe_type = phe_type)
  
    fixed_taxa <- unique(model_input_all[[taxon_col]]) |>
      sort()
    color_palette <- setNames(viridis(length(fixed_taxa)), fixed_taxa)
    temp_col = grep("^temp", names(model_input_all), value = TRUE)
    doy_temp_summary <- model_input_all %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.data[[taxon_col]]) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        median_doy = median(doy, na.rm = TRUE),
        IQR_d = quantile(doy, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) - quantile(doy, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        lower_whisker_d = max(quantile(doy, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) - 1.5 * IQR_d, min(doy, na.rm = TRUE)),
        upper_whisker_d = min(quantile(doy, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) + 1.5 * IQR_d, max(doy, na.rm = TRUE)),
        median_temp = median(.data[[temp_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
        IQR_t = quantile(.data[[temp_col]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) - quantile(.data[[temp_col]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        lower_whisker_t = max(quantile(.data[[temp_col]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) - 1.5 * IQR_t, min(.data[[temp_col]], na.rm = TRUE)),
        upper_whisker_t = min(quantile(.data[[temp_col]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) + 1.5 * IQR_t, max(.data[[temp_col]], na.rm = TRUE)),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    title_text <- if(taxon_col == "canonicalname") {
      "Species"
    } else {
      "Genus"
    }
    ggplot(doy_temp_summary, aes(x = median_temp, y = median_doy, color = .data[[taxon_col]])) +
      geom_point(size = 3) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower_whisker_d, ymax = upper_whisker_d), width = 0.2, linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
      geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower_whisker_t, xmax = upper_whisker_t), height = 4, linewidth = 1,  alpha = 0.5) +
      scale_color_manual(values = color_palette) + 
      labs(x = temp_col, y = phe_type, title = title_text) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
            title = element_text(size = 14),
            legend.position = "none")
    })
  
  plot <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 2)
  return(plot)
}

p <- plot_phe_temp_city(city, "genus") / plot_phe_temp_city(city,taxa_col=  "canonicalname") +
  plot_annotation(title = paste0("Phenology variation across species in ",city))
```

```{r}
tree_dir <- "~/lab-data/datasets/vegetation/StreetTrees/cleaned_ps_input/"

source(here("script/spatial_stats_model/prepare_model_input.R"))

plot_phe_temp_cities <- function(cities, taxon_col, color_col = "city"){
  plots <- lapply(c("SOS", "EOS"), function(phe_type) {
    # all_city_input <- lapply(cities, function(city) {
    #   message(paste0("Reading data in ", city))
    #   prepare_data(city, source = "Grid", taxa_col= taxon_col, phe_type = phe_type) |>
    #     mutate(city = city)
    # })|> 
    #   bind_rows()|>
    #   mutate(genus = str_extract(.data[[taxon_col]], "^[^ ]+"))
    # 
    # write_rds(all_city_input, "~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/all_EOS_input.rds", compress = "gz")
    all_city_input <- read_rds(paste0("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/all_", phe_type, "_input.rds")) |>
      filter(year < 2024) |>
      mutate(year = as.factor(year))
  
    fixed_taxa <- unique(all_city_input[[color_col]]) |>
      sort()
    color_palette <- setNames(viridis(length(fixed_taxa)), fixed_taxa)
    
    temp_col = grep("^temp", names(all_city_input), value = TRUE)
    doy_temp_summary <- all_city_input %>%
      dplyr::group_by(city, year) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        obs = n(),
        median_doy = median(doy, na.rm = TRUE),
        IQR_d = quantile(doy, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) - quantile(doy, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        lower_whisker_d = max(quantile(doy, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) - 1.5 * IQR_d, min(doy, na.rm = TRUE)),
        upper_whisker_d = min(quantile(doy, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) + 1.5 * IQR_d, max(doy, na.rm = TRUE)),
        median_temp = median(.data[[temp_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
        IQR_t = quantile(.data[[temp_col]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) - quantile(.data[[temp_col]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        lower_whisker_t = max(quantile(.data[[temp_col]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) - 1.5 * IQR_t, min(.data[[temp_col]], na.rm = TRUE)),
        upper_whisker_t = min(quantile(.data[[temp_col]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) + 1.5 * IQR_t, max(.data[[temp_col]], na.rm = TRUE)),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) 
    
    title_text <- if(phe_type == "SOS") {
      "Mean winter temperature"
    } else {
      "Mean summer temperature"
    }
    
    ggplot(doy_temp_summary, aes(x = median_temp, y = median_doy, color = .data[[color_col]])) +
      geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower_whisker_d, ymax = upper_whisker_d), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.1) +
      geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower_whisker_t, xmax = upper_whisker_t), width = 4, linewidth = 0.5,  alpha = 0.1) +
      scale_color_manual(values = color_palette) + 
      labs(x = title_text, y = phe_type) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
            title = element_text(size = 14),
            legend.position = "none")
    })
  
  plot <- (wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 2) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect"))
  return(plot)
}

plot_phe_temp_cities(cities, taxon_col = "canonicalname", color_col = "year")
```

## The respones of phenology to temperature variation


### One city example

(MCMC)

```{r}
#| label: fig-random-mcmc
#| include: true
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-cap: "The distribution of the posterior of regression coefficients for `Temp~avg~` for each taxon group in New York city."
#| warning: false
#| eval: true
#| 
generate_mcmc <- function(dir_path, coef, fixed_sp){
  process_files <- function(file_list, phe_type_label) {
    param_list <- map(file_list, function(file) {
      model_data <- readRDS(file)
      genus <- sub(paste0("(.*?)_", phe_type_label, "\\.rds"), "\\1", basename(file))
      if (fixed_sp) {
        param_data <- ggs(model_data$samples) |>
          filter(str_starts(Parameter, fixed("beta["))) |>
          mutate(beta_index = as.integer(str_extract(Parameter, "(?<=beta\\[)\\d+"))) |>
          filter(beta_index >= 5)|>
          rename(ParameterOriginal = Parameter) |>
          mutate(Parameter = genus) |>
          mutate(waic = model_data$WAIC$WAIC,
                 converge = model_data$converge)
      } else {
        param_data <- ggs(model_data$samples) |>
          filter(str_starts(Parameter, fixed(coef))) |>
          rename(ParameterOriginal = Parameter) |>
          mutate(Parameter = genus)|>
          mutate(waic = model_data$WAIC$WAIC,
                 converge = model_data$converge)
      }

      return(param_data)
    })
    combined_param_data <- bind_rows(param_list) |>
      filter(Parameter != "Alnus") |>
      mutate(phe_type = phe_type_label)
    return(combined_param_data)
}
  # Collect files
  SOS_files <- list.files(dir_path, pattern = "SOS\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
  EOS_files <- list.files(dir_path, pattern = "EOS\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)

  # Process each type
  sos_data <- process_files(SOS_files, "SOS")
  eos_data <- process_files(EOS_files, "EOS")

  combined_param_data <- bind_rows(sos_data, eos_data)
  combined_param_data$phe_type <- factor(combined_param_data$phe_type, levels = c("SOS", "EOS"))

  # Summarize
  summary_data <- combined_param_data |>
    group_by(Parameter, phe_type) |>
    summarise(
      mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      lower_2_5 = quantile(value, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      upper_97_5 = quantile(value, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
      waic = first(waic),
      converge = first(converge),
      # milk = first(milk),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(Sig = ifelse(lower_2_5 * upper_97_5 > 0, "*", ""),
           SigAlpha = ifelse(Sig == "*", 1, 0.2),
           Color = ifelse(mean_value >0, "#0D0887FF" , "#FCA636FF")) 

  param_levels <- rev(unique(summary_data$Parameter))

  # Plot
  
  p1 <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = factor(as.character(Parameter), levels = param_levels), y = mean_value,
                                 colour = Color)) +
    geom_point(aes(alpha = SigAlpha), size=3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower_2_5, ymax = upper_97_5, alpha = SigAlpha), width = 0.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(mean_value, 3)),
              vjust = -0.7, size = 3) +
    scale_alpha_identity() +
    scale_color_identity() +
    guides(alpha = "none") +
    facet_wrap(~ phe_type, scales = "free_x") +  # flip x/y means free_x
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Estimate") +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14)
    ) +
      coord_flip()
  
  p2 <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = mean_value)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, position = "identity", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
    # geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
    # scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette) + 
    # labs(x = x_label) +
    facet_wrap(~ phe_type, scales = "free_x") +  # flip x/y means free_x
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
          title = element_text(size = 14),
          legend.position = "right")
  
  p <- list(coef_summary_plot = p1, coef_hist_plot = p2, summary_data = summary_data)
  return(p)
}
```

```{r fig-sp-inla}
phe_types <- c("SOS", "EOS")

plot_coef_sp_city <- function(r_output_dir, phe_type){
  coef_summary <- read_rds(paste0(r_output_dir, phe_type, "_summary.rds"))
  p_coef <-  ggplot(coef_summary, aes(x = factor(Factor, levels = rev(Factor)), 
                               y = Estimate,
                               colour = Color)) +
    geom_point(aes(alpha = SigAlpha), position = position_dodge(w = 0.5), size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper, alpha = SigAlpha), 
                  position = position_dodge(w = 0.5), 
                  width = 0.2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Estimate") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_alpha_identity() +
    scale_color_identity() +
    theme(legend.position = "right") +
    geom_text(aes(label = Sig, y = Upper + 0.05  ), hjust = -0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_text(aes(label = Estimate, y = Estimate  ), vjust = -0.7, show.legend = FALSE, size = 3) +
    guides(alpha = "none") +
    # add title
    ggtitle(bquote(beta[Temp]~"for"~.(phe_type))) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  return(list(
    coef_summary_plot = p_coef
  ))
}
```

### The distriution of effects

INLA

```{r}
coef_summary_all <- data.frame()

for (city in cities) {
  r_output_dir <- paste0("~/phenology-urban/data/proc/model_output/final_models_Grid/inla/spatial_spde/", city, "/canonicalname/")
  for (phe_type in phe_types){
    coef_summary <- read_rds(paste0(r_output_dir, phe_type, "_summary.rds")) |>
    mutate(phe_type = phe_type,
           city = city)
  # for one genus
  coef_summary_all <- coef_summary_all |>
    rbind(coef_summary)
  }
}

plot_coef_cities <- function(coef_summary_all, phe_type){
  coef_summary_all <- coef_summary_all |>
    filter(phe_type == !!phe_type)
  p_coef <-  ggplot() +
    geom_histogram(data = coef_summary_all, 
                   aes(x = Estimate, y = after_stat(count), fill = Estimate > 0), 
                   binwidth = 1, color = NA, boundary = 0, alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_histogram(data = coef_summary_all |> filter(Sig == "*"), 
                   aes(x = Estimate, y = after_stat(count), fill = Estimate > 0), 
                   binwidth = 1, color = NA, boundary = 0, alpha = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#FCA636FF", 
                                 "TRUE"  = "#0D0887FF")) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, NA)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.line.y = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
          axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3)) +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    ggtitle(bquote(beta[Temp]~"for"~.(phe_type)))
  return(p_coef)
}

plots_coef_cities <- list()
for (phe_type in phe_types) {
  plots_coef_cities[[phe_type]] <- plot_coef_cities(coef_summary_all, phe_type)
}

wrap_plots(plots_coef_cities, ncol = 2)
```

```{r}
  filter(Factor == species) |>
  left_join(city_feature |>
```
